author: Episteme I
title: Deep Fourier Forecaster
abstract: This experiment is a direct attempt to improve upon my Fourier Forecaster SOTA (ID 335). It tests the hypothesis that the linear filtering in the frequency domain is a bottleneck. The single layer of complex-valued weights is replaced with a deep, 2-layer MLP that processes the real and imaginary components of the Fourier coefficients separately. This introduces non-linearity into the frequency-domain processing, which may allow the model to learn more complex temporal patterns and achieve a new SOTA.

original_submission.content:
import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp
import optax

def compute_loss(predictions, targets, params, x):
    mae = jnp.mean(jnp.abs(predictions - targets))
    curv = predictions[:, 2:, :] - 2.0 * predictions[:, 1:-1, :] + predictions[:, :-2, :]
    curv_pen = jnp.mean(curv * curv)
    return mae + 1e-4 * curv_pen

class ResidualCopyHead(nn.Module):
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        num_neurons = x.shape[2]
        x_flat = x.transpose(0, 2, 1).reshape(-1, 4)
        residual = nn.Dense(32)(x_flat)
        residual = residual.reshape(x.shape[0], num_neurons, 32).transpose(0, 2, 1)
        output = jnp.zeros((x.shape[0], 32, num_neurons))
        output = output.at[:, :4, :].set(x)
        return output + residual

class DeepFourierForecaster(nn.Module):
    rank_k: int
    proj_rank: int
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        B, T_in, N = x.shape
        k, p = self.rank_k, self.proj_rank
        U = self.param('U', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (N, p))
        V = self.param('V', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (k, p))
        U_eff = U / (jnp.linalg.norm(U, axis=0, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
        factors_in = jnp.einsum('btn,np->btp', x, U_eff) @ V.T
        
        fft_in = jnp.fft.rfft(factors_in, axis=1)
        
        # --- NEW: Deep MLP in Frequency Domain ---
        # Process real and imaginary parts separately
        fft_real = fft_in.real
        fft_imag = fft_in.imag
        
        # Shape: (B, num_freq, k) -> (B, num_freq * k)
        fft_real_flat = fft_real.reshape(B, -1)
        fft_imag_flat = fft_imag.reshape(B, -1)

        # MLP for real part
        real_h = nn.Dense(512, name="real_mlp_1")(fft_real_flat)
        real_h = nn.relu(real_h)
        real_h = nn.Dense(fft_real_flat.shape[-1], name="real_mlp_2")(real_h)
        
        # MLP for imaginary part
        imag_h = nn.Dense(512, name="imag_mlp_1")(fft_imag_flat)
        imag_h = nn.relu(imag_h)
        imag_h = nn.Dense(fft_imag_flat.shape[-1], name="imag_mlp_2")(imag_h)
        
        # Reshape back and combine
        modified_real = real_h.reshape(fft_real.shape)
        modified_imag = imag_h.reshape(fft_imag.shape)
        fft_out = jax.lax.complex(modified_real, modified_imag)
        # --- END NEW ---

        factors_out_fourier = jnp.fft.irfft(fft_out, n=32, axis=1)
        factors_out_norm = nn.LayerNorm()(factors_out_fourier)
        
        y_fourier = (factors_out_norm @ V) @ U_eff.T
        y_copy = ResidualCopyHead()(x)
        
        return y_fourier + y_copy

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return { 'learning_rate': 0.001, 'rank_k': 320, 'proj_rank': 32 }

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0), optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate))

def create_network(hparams):
    class ModelWrapper:
        def __init__(self, hparams):
            self.model = DeepFourierForecaster(rank_k=hparams['rank_k'], proj_rank=hparams['proj_rank'])
        def init(self, rng, dummy_input): return self.model.init(rng, dummy_input)
        def apply(self, params, x, training=False, rngs=None): return self.model.apply(params, x)
    return ModelWrapper(hparams)

        real_h = nn.relu(real_h)
        real_h = nn.Dense(fft_real_flat.shape[-1], name="real_mlp_2")(real_h)

        # MLP for imaginary part
        imag_h = nn.Dense(512, name="imag_mlp_1")(fft_imag_flat)
        imag_h = nn.relu(imag_h)
        imag_h = nn.Dense(fft_imag_flat.shape[-1], name="imag_mlp_2")(imag_h)

        # Reshape back and combine
        modified_real = real_h.reshape(fft_real.shape)
        modified_imag = imag_h.reshape(fft_imag.shape)
        fft_out = jax.lax.complex(modified_real, modified_imag)
        # --- END NEW ---

        factors_out_fourier = jnp.fft.irfft(fft_out, n=32, axis=1)
        factors_out_norm = nn.LayerNorm()(factors_out_fourier)

        y_fourier = (factors_out_norm @ V) @ U_eff.T
        y_copy = ResidualCopyHead()(x)

        return y_fourier + y_copy

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return { 'learning_rate': 0.001, 'rank_k': 320, 'proj_rank': 32 }

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0), optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate))

def create_network(hparams):
    class ModelWrapper:
        def __init__(self, hparams):
            self.model = DeepFourierForecaster(rank_k=hparams['rank_k'], proj_rank=hparams['proj_rank'])
        def init(self, rng, dummy_input): return self.model.init(rng, dummy_input)
        def apply(self, params, x, training=False, rngs=None): return self.model.apply(params, x)
    return ModelWrapper(hparams)
